nodes.text: In conclusion, I haven't been embarrassed like that in years! I'm disappointed in all of you!

nodes.text: A squared plus B squared equals C squared?

nodes.text: Nah, I think I'll just beat you instead!
Lars starts to drive hard to the hoop, right past Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: No way!
Ben overcompensates his speed! Lars suddenly stops, and Ben goes flying past him!
Lars easily makes a wide-open bank shot!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Crap!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Meaning?
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Meaning you suck, and your face is ugly!
Lars is visibly affected, fumbling the ball off his foot!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Whoops!
It rolls off of Ben's leg, heading toward the out of bounds line!
Before it crosses the line, Owen dives on it and calls a timeout!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Great hustle, Owen!

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: Just showing some heart!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Like... Like... Like something really bad.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Ericson! Get in there! Andy only needs to rest for a minute, so keep it to just two or three mistakes!

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: You got it, Coach! I'm only going to make one mistake at most!
Lars gets the ball, still with a lot of energy in his steps!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm so tired... The only way I can beat him is to psych him out!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: You must feel like the first law of thermodynamics... You can't win!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, you must feel like...
Ben aims for the ball, but Lars gets the shot off clean!
Lars sinks the shot!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: What happened to stopping him, Kale?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm trying!
Lars can't see the hoop when he shoots!
He misses his shot off the front of the rim, and Spencer's there for the rebound!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: This ball is mine! I own it like I own your faces!
Spencer gives the ball to Ben.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Nice D, Kale!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Thanks!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Gotcha!
Lars instinctively goes up for a shot, just as Ben collides with Lars's body!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Oop!
The whistle blows, and the ref calls Ben for a foul. Lars is awarded two free throws.

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: Don't reach in like that, Kale! We can't afford you fouling out!
Lars sinks both shots. Jacob brings the ball up for Twin Branches...
He passes it to Andy, who shoots a long jump shot... And completely misses the hoop!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whoops!
Ben just stands there and watches as Lars nails a jump shot in his face!

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Kale! Are you playing zombie defense?!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Sorry...

nodes.speaker: Spencer

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: Whoops!

Lars takes the bait, picking up his dribble and lining up his shot!
Ben reaches out, trying to block...
Ben hesitates for a moment, then decides to go for the ball!
Ben reaches in to strip the ball from Lars!
Ben hesitates for a moment, then decides to go for the ball!
Ben strips the ball out of Lars's hands! He passes it off to Andy, who dribbles down and sinks a fifteen-foot jump shot!

nodes.speaker: Andy
nodes.text: With my eye closed!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Ha ha! Nice shot, Andy!
Ben stays patient, holding his ground.
Then Lars picks up the ball!
Ben reaches in to strip the ball from Lars!
Ben waits, holding his position as Lars keeps dribbling...
Willow Glen comes back, getting the ball in Lars's hands again. Ben gets into his defensive stance in front of him.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: My game is like space, always expanding!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: My defense is like a black hole, nothing escapes it!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This time, I'll let him go right... The second he picks up the ball, I'll strip it from him!
Lars jukes to the right, but keeps dribbling...
Ben forces Lars to his offhand, his left!
Lars pulls up for a quick shot, but Ben is there to block it!
Jacob scoops up the ball... And dribbles by his man for an easy score!

nodes.speaker: Jacob
nodes.text: Ask and you shall receive!
Score Up!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: If I had known it was that easy, I would have asked for more!

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Ha!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Why did I let him go that way?

nodes.speaker: Jacob

nodes.text: And it's never hard to convince the heart to go after what it already wants...

nodes.text: At least that's what I learned from the last rom-com I saw! In the final scene, the romantic leads got married and everyone danced! What a twist!

nodes.text: What about you, Kale? What are you going to do?

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'm going to shut down Lars.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: That's a tough task, man. He's got like all their points!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Well, he won't be getting any more...

nodes.speaker: Spencer

Ben's eyes drift to the crowd, searching, looking for Emily... Then sadly back to Spencer.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I don't think there's much I can do about that. I'm just off my game.

nodes.text: It's the end of the game. And with just ten seconds left, Willow Glen is only ahead by two points.
Jacob dribbles the ball across half-court and flips it to Erik.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Andy's being double-teamed!
Spencer sets a screen for Ben!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: This is it... My chance to win the game with a three-pointer!
Ben's eyes drift to the crowd for just a moment... And he remembers that Emily isn't there.

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: She's at the dance...

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Dude!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Oh!
Ben curls off Spencer's screen, catches a behind-the-back pass from Erik, turns, and shoots!
The ball hangs in the air, falls toward the hoop...
And clangs off the back of the rim!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I missed... We lost...
As the Twin Branches players sulk off the court, Lars walks past Ben and chucks him with his shoulder.

nodes.speaker: Lars
nodes.text: Survival of the fittest... And it looks like you guys are dodos!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: I'll crush you in Sectionals! I swear it!

nodes.speaker: Lars

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: Grr!

nodes.speaker: Coach
nodes.text: I'll see you on the bus!
He leaves in a huff, grumbling about his ex-wife.

nodes.text: We're still not out yet, Spence. Maybe our next game against Wilson High's what really matters!

nodes.text: We're done, man!
Remembering Madame Fortuna, Owen glances unconsciously off to the left...

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: It's just a fortune teller, guys. I mean, she told me something completely unhelpful and vague. It doesn't mean anything!
Nearby, Nick snaps a picture of the team.

nodes.speaker: Spencer
nodes.text: Now is `not` the time, Brown!

nodes.speaker: Nick
nodes.text: Sorry... I just needed a candid for the paper. I'll put the camera away.

nodes.speaker: Owen
nodes.text: If I hear the name Lars chanted ever again, I will rip my own ears off.

nodes.speaker: Erik

nodes.speaker: Erik
nodes.text: Well, I mean, at least it was quick--

nodes.speaker: Ben

Ben starts scrambling through his gym bag for his phone! He checks the time!

nodes.speaker: Ben
nodes.text: The dance! It isn't over! We can still make it!
Out in the parking lot, all is still save for the lazy sound of a few crickets...
Then the locker room doors burst open! The basketball team sprints out, running toward the bus!

nodes.speaker: Ben

Owen follow behind him, when he has a sudden, unexplainable feeling...
He watches as Ben heads down the hallway, toward the gym entrance, off to the right...
Make your choice!
Go left.|Go right.
What do you do?
Owen ignores his feeling and follows Ben off to the right.
Later, as the dance winds down, Owen is sitting with Paige, her friends, and some of the basketball players...
What did you think of the game, Paige?
It was okay. You dove on the floor a lot.
Every time you did that, she said you had a nice--
There's a `thunk` underneath the table.
Uh... Diving form.
Heh. I'm sure.
Paige blushes.
Owen looks over and sees some commotion at the table where Emily, Sam, Kimi, and Nate are...
Excuse me...
He walks over...
What's up?
No one's seen $ZOE. Have you?
What?
I messed up and then she fled out the door! No one's seen her!
She probably went `home,` Nate!
What'd you do?
I... I might have accidentally told her how I paid Wes to tell her that you and Paige kissed!
Why did you do that?! How did you even know that?!
Owen clenches his left hand!
Go `left!` Left fist! This must be what Madame Fortuna was referring to!
Owen clocks Nate across the face with his left hand! Nate sprawls across the floor!
After a year-long stint in Boot Camp, at Madame Fortuna's parlor...
Owen storms in!
I've been expecting you, though I thought you might be here sooner!
Owen's face is damaged by sun, his clothes ragged, his body scarred.
Do you have any idea of the kind of torment I've been through!
Yes, as a matter of fact I know exactly what you've been through.
Go left, you said! Go left! Nothing's gone right since I started going left.
Ha! That's funny!
Grr!
Funny... To some of us anyway.
The problem is simple, Owen. You blew your moment to go left a long time ago.
What? When?
The moment you got off the bus...
And Owen remembers that feeling, the one he ignored, and his whole body sinks.
He knows, without a doubt, that...
Owen follows his instincts and heads off to the left, around the other side of the gym.
This must be the choice Madame Fortuna was referring to at the Halloween Dance!
He rounds the corner...
Just as the side door flies open and $ZOE comes storming out!
Stupid! Boys! Grr!
$ZOE? Are you okay?
Owen?! What are you doing here?
The short answer? We got our butts kicked and we got them kicked `quickly.`
I'm sorry...
What's going on? Something wrong?
Nothing I want to talk about.
Make your choice!
Ask about it again.|Change the subject.
What do you do?
Score Up!
Yeah, if I owed someone `a gift` and `a confession`, I wouldn't want to talk about anything else either.
$ZOE laughs, remembering the deal they made that afternoon.
I needed that. Thanks.
She takes a deep, relaxing breath.
No problem.
Wait... Are you saying my embarrassing song wasn't enough to make up for scheduling the dance today?
Nope. You owed three things. That means you're two short.
Are you sure? Because it seems like something's wrong. You know you can always--
I `said` I didn't want to talk about it, Owen!
Are all guys just insensitive jerks who do whatever they feel like?!
Uh... I just wanted to make sure you were okay, but if you'd rather be alone...
$ZOE sighs.
No, I'm sorry. I'm just taking out my feelings on you. Please, stay.
Owen sits down on the steps. $ZOE joins him.
Maybe this is a bad time, but you do still owe me a gift and a confession...
Remember? You sang a song this afternoon to embarrass yourself?
$ZOE nods.
Right... A gift...
$ZOE looks around for something that might work as a gift for Owen.
Can I get you a gift card?
Same as with `the embarrassment,` it only really works if it's heartfelt.
Okay... I can do heartfelt.
Can we walk?
Sure...
You are now playing as $ZOE...
$ZOE and Owen leave the area of the dance and walk out onto the track. The stars shine overhead.
My gift is something I'm going to tell you... Is that okay?
Depends on what you say.
Fair enough...
$ZOE looks up at the stars for a moment, then to Owen.
You know, when I first met you, I thought you were really cool.
Oh yeah? Must have been my `groovy` haircut.
Okay, now I'm `sure` that was the wrong impression. Seriously though, you seemed really cool.
What did I even say to you?
Um... I don't remember the exact words...
So how do you know I was being cool if you can't remember what I said?
Well, there's an easy way to find out. Role-playing!
$ZOE backs up a few steps, takes some deep breaths, and approaches Owen.
Hi, I'm $ZOE. Are you lost?
Owen grins.
I was lost... Until I found you.
That's it. See? You're pretty cool, right?
Hang on, you're breaking character! What do you say next?
Make your choice!
We're going to have a wonderful friendship.|Wow, most transfers are shy on their first day.
What do you say next?
I'm not most transfer students.
Oh really? Then what are you?
Score Up!
Super cool?
Of course!
Success! Coolness proven!
I'm pretty sure you veered off-script there.
Who? Me?
I'm pretty sure most people don't say that the first time they meet someone.
What if I added on that I'd go to great lengths to make sure you're okay before the State Championship game?
I guess that'd make sense... But only if I said I'd be there to cheer you up when you're worried about winning Social Chair!
That would have been a weird conversation to have...
Especially since I had no intention of playing football, and Social Chair wasn't even on your radar!
Well, I was right about us being wonderful friends.
Yeah. That's what we are. Friends.
Yeah...
Wait... Was Owen thinking we were something more?
They round a corner of the track...
So... I'm cool. Was that all you wanted to tell me?
Not all... I was just thinking about the past. Like how you confronted Ken about what you'd done... How you'd hurt him...
I don't remember if I said anything about it then, but that was really...
Make your choice!
Brave.|Impressive.
That was really...
Impressive? What's impressive about putting a guy in the hospital?
Nothing. But you made a mistake. Everyone makes them.
But not everyone can face them the way you did. And that impressed me.
I didn't talk to Ken to make myself look good, $ZOE.
I know! That's not what I'm saying.
And it wasn't about you either!
I'm not saying it was! I'm just saying that it had that effect, whether it was intended or not.
Oh...
Anyway...
How so? I put the guy in the hospital. There isn't anything brave about that.
You made a mistake. Everyone makes them.
Score Up!
But not everyone has the courage to face up to their mistakes, especially big ones like that.
I was... I was so proud to be your friend then.
It wasn't easy... I don't think I could have done it without you there.
I was prouder of you when you dealt with his brother.
There aren't many guys who'd show as much leniency as you did, knowing how he'd vandalized your stuff.
He was angry with me. And with good reason. He just didn't express it in the right way...
Besides, he was just a kid. What else was I going to do?
Hee... Did you attend some kind of compliment deflection school or something?
Well, tonight I lost a big basketball game...
And then I got a bunch of compliments from a pretty girl on a pretty night.
Suddenly, the loss doesn't hurt quite as deep. So, yeah, that was an `amazing` gift.
Did... Did you just call me pretty?
Uh... I called the `night` pretty. Let's, uh, let's head back.
Sure.
They walk together in silence for a while...
Soon, the sounds of the dance can be heard as they reach the same steps from before. Owen leans on the railing.
He seems deep in thought...
Someone said today that it's never hard to convince the heart to go after what it already wants.
What made you think of that?
Good company, I think.
Awww!
So... I've seen `an embarrassment` and I've received `a gift`... Will I be hearing `a confession` tonight too?
$ZOE takes a deep breath.
Well... I don't know if you know this, but I went with Nate to the dance tonight...
No, no I didn't. Is that your confession, because we all make bad decisions.
That's not my confession.
Oh...
Incidentally, it... It didn't go very well.
So... `That's` your confession, because I'll have to admit that's not very surpris--
No, no, that's not it either. Please, just let me get through this.
It's been a long night.
Sure.
What I want to say is that I only came here with Nate because I know he likes me...
And because he asked me...
But the guy I like, the guy I wanted to ask me... He didn't.
Wow. That's... That's a pretty good confession.
Almost. That wasn't quite it either. What I want to confess is this...
Paige appears from around the corner.
Owen! There you are! Just because your team lost doesn't mean you have to associate with other losers!
Great. Right on cue.
$ZOE...
Come on already! I've decided to take you away from this dumpy dance and treat you to a `real` party!
I know you don't deserve it, but I'm in a good mood.
I'm sorry, $ZOE. Paige came to my game. I... I should go with her.
I know. I get it...
Owen turns and heads off with Paige, leaving $ZOE by herself.
She sits back down on the steps... And cries.

Inside the gym, while Owen and $ZOE were outside...
The DJ puts on an uptempo song!
OMG! `Love is Like a Robot!` Come on, everyone, let's dance!
Not a bad song... But I'll leave the dancing to the preps.
Finally! A song worth moving to!
Sam and Kimi head out onto the dance floor and start dancing together!
Sam does a fancy move and bumps into someone behind her!
Excuse me.
Nick?! You're here?! Did the game end early?!
Yeah...
How'd it go?
Not a lot of happy pictures...
Oh... Poor guys.
Kimi smiles at Sam and dances away.
I haven't been here for very many songs, but this is like the first good song this DJ's played!
Ha! So true! You should have been here earlier!
An awkward moment passes between them...
This is... The part where I ask you to dance... But I'm not going to.
Wow. Smooth talker.
Oh, no! That totally came out wrong! I meant... I'm a really bad dancer!
Come on. You can't be that bad.
Well, you've seen me run. My dancing makes my running look graceful.
Yikes! If that's true, what are you doing on the `dance` floor?
To be honest, I was trying to take a shortcut to the punch bowl...
Sounds like the start of a bad country song.
{ Took a shortcut to the punch bowl... {
{ Took a punch from my ex... {
They share a laugh together, then...
Hey, Nick... I've been meaning to ask you... Are you okay?
Actually, I'm a little carsick from the crazy bus ride back, but--
That's not what I meant. I meant in general. In life.
It doesn't seem like you've ever talked to anyone about Sara...
And I know things weren't great between us at the time but I wanted to say that if you ever need to talk, you know where to find me.
Thanks...
So... Do you? Want to talk about it?
Not yet. I loved her, and that makes it hard.
If you ever need a shoulder to cry on...
It'll be yours.
You know, Sam, I've missed you.
Me?
Yeah, Sam, it's possible for someone to develop an emotional attachment toward you.
Some might call it friendship.
Ha...
Another awful slow song plays...
Sam and Nick groan at the same time and smile at each other.
So, you didn't really answer my question... How are you?
Honestly... Not good.
You sound like someone who could use a friend.
I could...
As the couples around them dance, Sam and Nick stay there, talking...
You are now playing as Ben...
On another part of the dance floor, Ben and Emily are dancing together...
I'm sorry that you guys lost... But I'm `so` happy you made it, Ben!
I'm happy I made it too! Any requests before the dance ends?
Yes! I don't want any drama! No discussions about our schedule, my dad, swimming, `or` basketball!
I just want to enjoy the company of my boyfriend.
I can get behind that.
Ben twirls Emily out and brings her back in, kissing her.
But, uh, I did promise your dad the next dance...
Hee hee! Who leads?
Him. Definitely him.
The two of them laugh and dance, happy to enjoy their night together...
And that's your bonus scene!
Hey SHS Fans! It's me, Emily!
Did you know that I'm the main character in Surviving High School, the novel?!
That's me right there over my shoulder! Weird, right?
The novel features me, Ben, Kimi, Spencer, and a lot of other cool Twin Branches students!
Anyway, the novel is available wherever awesome books are sold `and` is also available in digital form!
In fact, if you're interested, you can check it out right now!
Make your choice!
Yes, please!|No, thanks!
Do you want to check out the SHS novel in iBooks?
No problem! Thanks for playing, everyone! We love you!

Your grade for this episode is... Honor Roll Scholar!

I guess so...
Here's my chance to give Owen his gift! A bunch of heartfelt compliments!
Face it, Owen. You're...
Make your choice!
Compliment Owen!
Kind-hearted!|A good person!|Strong!
A guy!|A person!|A football player!
You're, you know, a guy who plays football... And... Um...
$ZOE's silence hangs there between them for eternity.
Really? That's all you can think of to compliment me? I play football?
That's not it! I mean, you also... Play basketball.
Wow. If this is heartfelt, I'd hate to see lackadaisical.
I'm sorry... I'm just emotionally drained.
Yeah, well, let's go back.
They walk back toward the gym, neither of them saying a word.
$ZOE gets the undeniable feeling that she's blown it, a feeling confirmed by the sad look on Owen's face.
You're kind-hearted and you're good and you're strong!
Okay! Enough! Enough! I can't deflect all this kindness!
Score Up!
So... Was this a good enough gift?

In the Twin Branches gym, everyone is excited!
Near the entrance...
Look at all these decorations! I feel like a movie star!
I love these white snowflake danglies!
What do you think, Manda-Panda?
I didn't bring my snow boots!
It's not real snow...
Is it a real gym?
Uh...
Emily and Kimi are returning from the restroom...
Can you believe how many couples there are?
I have a feeling some of them are just couples for tonight only...
Ryan walks by, his arm around Nicole.
And that's why I asked you. After Maria, you're the prettiest cheerleader.
Awww! I always thought I was third or fourth!
No way! Not with that shiny red hair! It's like a sports car on your head!
Let's go make out!
At least, I hope it's just for tonight. 'Cause gross.
I miss Ben.
Have you heard anything from him?
Emily checks her phone...
%s %s %s %s %s
Hee! He's coming!
At a table in the corner...
Surprisingly few aliens at the dance. I was expecting more costumes.
Yeah, seriously. No tentacles? No triple-eyed Martians? What's the point?
Ashley approaches the guys.
Want to dance, Dex?
Ub. Urp. Well!
Come on. Isn't this outer-space theme cool?!
Uh... Yes?
Ashley leads Dex away from the table...
Oh yeah, that's the point.
Denni and Colt pose for a photo while Autumn adjusts the camera...
You two have such a great energy! It's totally palpable and just `so` easy to photograph.
If only we could take a picture where both of us smile, instead of just me.
Hey, I smile! I'm smiling right now!
That's not a real smile!
I think he means he's smiling on the inside.
Yeah, what she said. I've got a big grin on the inside. The same grin I have every time I have to cram my feet into these fancy-pants shoes.
And I know I said `fancy-pants shoes.` Deal with it, Princess.
Okay, okay. If you take a good picture, we can leave the dance early and make out in the parking lot. How does that sound?
Does this face answer your question?
Over near the DJ, the swim team guys are hanging out...
So many hotties!
So many future Lee's girlfriends!
I just figured out your problem.
Who said we had a problem?
Both single. No date.
You're in the same boat, dude!
But that's just it, you try too hard.
The trick to getting a girl is to stop talking about it.
Cameron leaves the two of them there and immediately starts dancing with a beautiful girl.
Sometimes I hate that guy.
Taylor comes over to $ZOE and Sam's table. Emily and Kimi arrive at the same time.
Perfect job, Social Chair! I couldn't have done it better myself!
Ha! Never mind! I could have... But I'm, like, the only person who can do better than perfect!
Thanks, Taylor... Kind of.
Taylor wanders off to find Brendan. The girls are quiet. Then...
So much for Girls' Night... I miss dancing.
Hey, $ZOE, you're the only one of us with a date. Where's Nate?
He's getting some drinks.
Ooh! How come I didn't know that? It's gossip time!
What?
The moment your date leaves for drinks is the `perfect` time to get a mid-date scoop!
Uh-oh... Watch yourself. Kimi gets a little frenzied when gossip's near.
You seem sad! Is it because of Nate? Has he been boring? Did he beat someone up?
Ohmygosh! Did he try to get frisky with you?!
No! He didn't `get frisky` with me! How I'm feeling has nothing to do with Nate.
Suuuure.
Really, it's not about Nate. It's about Owen.
I'm just feeling--
Jealous? Of Paige?
I was going to say...
Make your choice!
Guilty.|Confused.
I was going to say...
Confused? Because you have a crush on Owen? Squee!
I didn't say that!
Because you have a crush on Nate?! Eeep!
You're putting words in my mouth!
Ohmygosh! Because you have a crush on both of them?! Aaaaah!
Have you lost your mind, Kimi?!
You haven't denied it, it must be true!
I'm just confused about what I'm feeling. I like Owen, but he's a friend, and he and Paige seem close.
And I like Nate, but I'm not sure about him.
This is just like a romance novel! If only one of them was a werewolf and one of them was a vampire!
I'm totally Team Owen!
Ooh. That sounds juicy!
It's not. It's actually pretty simple. I made Owen a promise, and I couldn't keep it.
I know it's not the biggest deal in the world. I know circumstances give me an excuse.
But I feel bad about it, and when I feel bad about something, it usually means I've done something wrong.
Or that you're too nice...
Maybe...
Well, you could always try to make it up to him.
I've already been working on that. You might remember my singing debut earlier today.
Don't remind us. My ears haven't stopped bleeding.
You know what? It sounds to me like you really care about him.
Score Up!
Yeah, that's probably the best way to put my feelings.
Nate comes up to the table, carefully balancing drinks for all the girls.
Ladies...
Thanks, Nate.
He holds $ZOE's gaze as he hands her a drink. His brow furrows.
You okay?
Yeah, I'm fine.
Uh huh. I know what 'I'm fine' means.
He holds out his hand for her.
Dance?
Sure.
She takes his hand, and the two of them walk out onto the dance floor. Nate holds $ZOE close, and they dance together.
So... Want to tell me what's got the always-happy, always-cheery $ZOE down?
It's complicated.
Heh. Let me guess... Howard's gone. Owen's at a basketball game because you scheduled the dance today...
Paige is probably there cheering him on. And you're here, stuck with me.
Make your choice!
Don't be hard on yourself.|'Stuck' isn't the word I'd use.
What do you say?
In fact, I'd just omit it completely...
I'm here, with you.
I like that a lot better.
Score Up!
I thought you might.
I wasn't being hard on myself at all. I was just expressing what `you` were feeling.
What do you mean?
I know I'm a pretty good catch. I'm the quarterback, I look good tonight, and I have never used 'body spray'.
That last one's a huge plus.
Joking aside, when are you going to see me as more than a backup plan?
You're not my backup, Nate.
I'm not even going to ask, but we both know if Owen were around, you'd have gone to the dance with him.
$ZOE doesn't say anything.
Uh huh.
Anyway, did I get that right? The many reasons for $ZOE's sadness?
I'm just so confused, Nate...
Howard, Owen, Paige, Social Chair, and--
And me?
Yeah, and you. I'm completely mixed up right now...
Nate holds $ZOE closer and brings his voice down low.
I want to tell you a secret. I've never really told anyone this, but I think it might help.
Oh, you don't have to... Are you sure?
I am...
A long time ago, my dad arranged for a college football scout to come over to our estate.
Really? When?
I was in middle school at the time, but if high school guys can play pro sports, why not?
Anyway, my dad kept telling me how important it was that I impress this guy.
The more he hyped it, the more nervous I got.
I can imagine!
The day arrived, and all my attention was on this tryout...
Then my mom came home and announced that she was pregnant with my baby sister.
No way! I didn't know you had a sister!
Yup. She's adorable.
So... What happened?
This is the part that's hard to tell you about...
I couldn't handle the news. I couldn't handle two big events at the same time.
And... And I fainted.
No!
Yup. I fell over right there in the kitchen, knocked my head on the counter, and my parents had to drive me to the hospital!
Ohmygosh!
It was crazy. I've never told anyone because it's hard to be the leader of the football team when you're also the guy who faints.
Hee! It'll be our secret. But wait... What happened with the scout?
He's still around.
$ZOE, I'm a tough guy.
But things can get overwhelming even for guys like me. What I'm saying... It's okay to be overwhelmed when you've got a lot going on.
Thanks, Nate.
So... Did you end up with a scar from where you hit your head?
Yeah, check it out.
Nate pulls back and lifts up part of his hair, exposing a scar along the side of his head. $ZOE touches it...
If anyone asks, dirtbike accident.
Hee. Much cooler.
Nate takes $ZOE's hand.
Maybe I can clarify one of your points of confusion... The point about me.
Their eyes meet.
I'm into you, $ZOE. I've been into you from day one.
She blushes, staring at their feet. Nate holds her chin and lifts her head back up, their eyes meeting again.
Nate...
You're who I want. You're beautiful, kind-hearted, and...
...And you make me want to be a better guy.
That's really `really` sweet, Nate.
But?
I wasn't going to say anything more. You've just been... Really sweet.
Nate leans forward to kiss $ZOE... And she doesn't move away.
Is this actually going to happen?
Nate gets closer...
I'm `so` glad I was patient...
Closer...
I'm `so` glad I asked you out...
Closer... $ZOE can feel the heat emanating from his lips.
I am `so` glad that Paige and Owen kissed.
Hurry!
Pull back!|Do nothing!
What do you do?
$ZOE does nothing as Nate's lips touch hers, kissing her!
For one moment, she feels like this is right...
Then, something clicks, and she pulls away!
What? What is it?
Wait... What does their kiss have to do with us?
$ZOE pulls back from Nate, not allowing him to kiss her.
Score Up!
Wait... What does their kiss have to do with us?
Just that if Owen and Paige hadn't kissed, you'd never--
How do you even `know` that they kissed?!
$ZOE gasps and separates herself from Nate's arms!
You `paid` Wes to tell me they hooked up, didn't you? You're the `interested party` he was talking about?
Uh, well, wait--
Hurry!
Slap Nate!
What do you do?
I can't believe I let you kiss me!
$ZOE moves her hand to slap Nate, but she stops herself!
You're not worth it, you jerk!
Or maybe deep down you know that what I did was necessary!
Grr!
$ZOE slaps Nate!
Score Up!
How could you, Nate?! How could you do that?!
$ZOE, wait!
She storms out of the gym!
Just a message that says...
%s %s %s %s %s
Whatever that means...
Nothing... I hope the basketball team is winning, at least.
You are now playing as Owen...
Outside, the basketball team bus arrives.
Enjoy your dance! Get ready to run at our next practice!
Before he can finish, Ben has already leapt from the bus!
Don't end the dance! I'm coming, Emily!

pov_note: Multi-POV episode. `pov` on a segment is the playable character in control on entry; a node's `set_pov` switches the current POV mid-stream (these are the game's 'You are now playing as X' cards). A dialogue node's `side` is 'left' when the speaker is the current POV (the game shows the current main on the left) and 'right' otherwise. POV is propagated in execution order from `entry`; only main_characters can hold it.
